decisions.reason: The award-winning hipress probe carries a public commitment and visible success, so dropping it would write off a celebrated investment and contradict the firm's announced innovation direction.
The single-U probe is part of the geothermal line the firm has invested in and promoted, and the missing archived pages say nothing about its performance.
The surface technology supports the geothermal probe range the firm is publicly committed to, so it stays as part of that line.
Fire-protection steel profiles sit close to the core profile business, where development, certification investment and regulatory demand justify keeping them.
Slim steel profile systems are core to the firm's building-systems offer and reflect a sunk development investment that management would defend.
The decorative surface system is a lower-investment add-on with less visible commitment, but it has no evidence of failure, so it stays for now.
